name: The DataVerse
description: A neon synthwave-themed multi-site ecosystem combining a CMS, wiki, forum, and shared asset library — all developed locally in Laragon and deployed to iFastNet hosting.

context.project_overview: The DataVerse is a unified digital environment built for creative and gaming communities, centered around Star Citizen, Minecraft, osu!, Twitch streaming, music, and more. The goal is to integrate different web platforms under one cohesive UI, with shared colors, fonts, and assets.
platforms: OctoberCMS Core site / app layer (main pages, trackers, blog)

development_environment.local: Laragon running PHP 8.2, MariaDB, Apache, and Node.js for Tailwind build processes.
development_environment.production: iFastNet shared hosting using manual deployment of built assets (no Composer or NPM on server).

design_language.notes: UI elements glow with magenta/cyan highlights and minimal futuristic layout.

forum.purpose: Community forum for discussions and user engagement.
forum.goal: Provide social and discussion functionality in The DataVerse, styled to match the synthwave theme.
forum.Notes for Copilot: PHP-based, uses its own templating system; keep integrations read-only (no direct code modifications inside core XenForo files, suggestions for modifications only).

wiki.purpose: Knowledge base and lore documentation hub.
wiki.goal: Serve as The DataVerse encyclopedia, with shared design tokens and footer ('Neon knowledge pulsing since 2025').
wiki.Notes for Copilot: Any CSS or JS customization goes through /wiki/resources/ or MediaWiki:Citizen.css; use Codex design tokens when styling.

octobertest2.purpose: Core site — main entry point and content management layer.
octobertest2.goal: Integrate sub-sites, host trackers (Star Citizen cargo system, etc.), and render pages using TailwindCSS with shared assets.
octobertest2.Notes for Copilot: Treat this as the orchestrator app; extend with Tailor models, Tabulator tables, and vendor assets in /themes/dataverse/

assets.contents: Fonts, images, icons, CSS/JS vendor files.
assets.purpose: Centralized visual and UI resource library shared by all sub-projects.
assets.goal: Maintain consistent neon-synthwave branding across all sites. Maintain a single source of truth for The DataVerse visual identity (colors, typography, gradients, neon elements).
assets.Notes for Copilot: Use these assets as imports rather than duplicating per sub-project. Paths may be referenced relatively (e.g., ../assets/fonts/orbitron/...).

project_goals: Create a cohesive, multi-platform digital ecosystem.
Use TailwindCSS for theming and layout control.
Unify UI across MediaWiki, XenForo, and OctoberCMS.
Enable cross-site navigation and identity consistency.
Deploy easily from local Laragon to iFastNet using manual build packaging.

coding_focus: When suggesting code, align with the Tailwind neon-dark theme (#0a0a0f, #0ff, #f0f)
Prioritize consistency between environments (same fonts, color palette, and nav structure)
best_practices: Extend frameworks instead of editing core vendor files.
Keep output clean, modular, and production-ready.
copilot_guidance.style_inspiration: Think neon circuitry meets elegant modern minimalism — clean lines, glowing accents, and readable contrast.
